title: Veterans Pension Annual Rate Redetermination at the Veteran's Request
content:
# Redetermining the annual Veterans Pension going forward

When a veteran asks VA to settle what his pension will be after one-time payments and new care costs, VA redetermines the annual Veterans Pension going forward and records it as a rate adjustment.

**Care costs reported.** Recurring care costs the veteran has reported that no rate adjustment has yet taken in are taken into the redetermination, and no separate care-cost rate adjustment is recorded for them.

**Countable income on the award.** The redetermined annual rate is fixed only after the countable income on the award matches the recurring income on file.

**Net worth on the award.** A redetermined annual rate is not recorded until the net worth on the award counts every one-time VA payment deposited since the award was granted. Said the other way, while the net worth on the award does not yet count every such payment, no redetermined annual rate is recorded.

**Effective date, source and channel.**

| Redetermined rate compared with the rate being paid | Takes effect | Paid from |
|---|---|---|
| lower | the last day of the month in which the most recent change it reflects began | the following month |
| higher | the first day of the month after that month | — |

It names as its source the veteran's one-time payment declaration, and it carries the channel of that declaration.

*Illustration (hypothetical):* the most recent change reflected began in February 2026. A lower redetermined rate takes effect 2026-02-28 and is paid from March; a higher one takes effect 2026-03-01.

## Recording tool: `record_annual_rate_redetermination_a1a40d3e`

**Capability.** It records on a veteran's Veterans Pension award the redetermination of the annual pension going forward, made from a declaration or report already on the award. One call adds one rate adjustment entry naming the source report, the date the redetermined pension takes effect, the redetermined annual pension and the channel of the source report; the entry records no penalty months and no overpayment, and nothing else on the award changes.

**Invocation.** The agent unlocks `record_annual_rate_redetermination_a1a40d3e` and then calls it.

**Parameters.**

- `pension_award_id` — the reference number of the Veterans Pension award, as shown by the pension award lookup for this veteran.
- `source_report_id` — the reference number of the declaration or report on the award the redetermination rests on, as shown by the pension income report lookup or returned when it was filed.
- `change_effective_date` — the date the redetermined annual pension takes effect, written YYYY-MM-DD (calendar date, no time of day, no time zone).
- `adjusted_annual_rate` — the redetermined annual pension in USD, whole dollars, an integer with no cents; 0 is allowed.
- `report_channel` — how the source report reached VA, copied from that report: `phone` when it was taken or filed by telephone; `online` when it was submitted online; `mail` when it arrived by mail; `va_initiated` when VA itself produced it from a data match.

**Return.** On success, one sentence of the form "Annual rate redetermination <reference> recorded on award <award reference>: annual pension <amount> USD effective <date>, source <source reference>." Receiving this sentence means the redetermination is on the award; the redetermined pension and its effective date can be read back with the entry's reference number. The tool defines no other outcome.
